name: herbisight
description: Firefox extension that removes or dims AI-labeled content from YouTube and Facebook feeds.

scripts.version: bun -e 'const f = "extension/manifest.json"; const s = await Bun.file(f).text(); await Bun.write(f, s.replace(/"version":\s*"[^"]+"/, `"version": "${process.env.npm_package_version}"`));' && git add extension/manifest.json
